en.decryption: Reminds you that the Kandahar bilingual inscription uses Greek and Aramaic scripts, distinct from Brahmi/Kharosthi used elsewhere.

hi.title: M-A-S-K
hi.decryption: Reminds you that the Kandahar bilingual inscription uses Greek and Aramaic scripts, distinct from Brahmi/Kharosthi used elsewhere.

fact.en: Confusing the Kandahar Bilingual Edict (Greek/Aramaic) with standard Brahmi inscriptions.
fact.hi: Confusing the Kandahar Bilingual Edict (Greek/Aramaic) with standard Brahmi inscriptions.

fact.en: Assuming all edicts mention 'Ashoka' by name; many refer to him as 'Devanampiya Piyadassi'.
fact.hi: Assuming all edicts mention 'Ashoka' by name; many refer to him as 'Devanampiya Piyadassi'.

fact.en: Believing inscriptions are only in India; they exist in modern-day Afghanistan and Pakistan.
